British Tennis Star Emma Raducanu Withdraws from Wimbledon Due to Leg Injury

Emma Raducanu, the 23-year-old former U.S. Open champion, has withdrawn from her first-round match at Wimbledon due to a leg injury. The decision was announced on the eve of her match. This is a setback for Raducanu, who had been looking forward to competing in her first Grand Slam tournament since winning the U.S. Open last year.
